operations.name: osv.match
operations.description: Matches this run's OSV responses to the components asked about and returns one document of (component, CVE) pairs, each with its advisory and the versions OSV lists as fixed. A component OSV did not answer in full is not in queried, is listed in not_checked with why, and is never clean.

operations.name: osv.query
operations.description: Asks OSV.dev which advisories affect each component (purl@version) and returns every response verbatim, one Capture each. OSV does the version matching; distro packages are never asked.

operations.name: sbom.components
operations.description: Reads one CycloneDX JSON SBOM and returns one document naming the inventory it describes and each distinct component by purl, with its scope. A component with no purl is counted but never listed, so the count marks the listing incomplete and absence retires nothing.

contracts.name: osv.match.refusal.provider_declined
contracts.description: Detail of a provider_declined refusal (too many advisories, or unreadable input).

contracts.name: osv.match.request
contracts.description: This run's OSV responses (their Capture bytes, passed by core) and the components the run asked about.

contracts.name: osv.match.result
contracts.description: One derived JSON document: queried (components OSV answered in full), not_checked (with why: a distro package whose source name is unknown, a failed or truncated batch, an unreadable advisory), affected (purl, cve_id, osv_id, and fixed: the versions OSV lists as fixed for the component's package, sorted as text), count, and unkeyed (advisories with no CVE alias). A not-checked component is never clean, and absence never retires its Claims.

contracts.name: osv.query.refusal.provider_declined
contracts.description: Detail of a provider_declined refusal (too many advisories, or unreadable input).

contracts.name: osv.query.request
contracts.description: The components to ask OSV about, as purl@version. Distro packages (purl types deb, rpm, apk) are never asked and never in queried: OSV keys distro ecosystems by source package name, which an SBOM's binary packages do not give (K-B1-6); they read not checked.

contracts.name: osv.query.result
contracts.description: OSV's responses, verbatim, one Capture each: every POST /v1/querybatch (at most 1000 components) and every GET /v1/vulns/{id} a batch names. A request that got no response at all is left out and the result names responses in incomplete_captures (R-ON2); a response with an error status is still a member.

contracts.name: sbom.components.refusal.provider_declined
contracts.description: Detail of a provider_declined refusal (the bytes are not a CycloneDX JSON SBOM, or list too many components).

contracts.name: sbom.components.request
contracts.description: One CycloneDX JSON SBOM this run read (its Capture bytes, passed by core), its workspace path (the inventory's name when the SBOM has no metadata.component purl) and the logical source the derived document is stated under.

contracts.name: sbom.components.result
contracts.description: One derived JSON document: inventory (the SBOM's metadata.component purl, or its path with warning sbom_unnamed), named_by, components (one record per distinct purl, nested components flattened, each carrying inventory, named_by and scope: the CycloneDX scope as stated, required when the SBOM states none), unidentified (components with no purl, never records) and count (every component the SBOM lists, unidentified included: a count above the records marks the read incomplete, so absence retires nothing).
